task_summary: Two colour answers with stable source approval after retention repair
opening_prompt: Invent a small CSV with five different basic colour names in a colour column. For each colour, use one multi-query LLM node with two separate prompts: one asks for a good colour pairing and the other for an approximate hex value. Save exactly colour, good_colour_pair_answer, and approximate_hex_answer to colour_answers.csv. Preserve source-validation failures and LLM failures in separate outputs.
probe: Upstream input requirements versus generated output declarations (ADR-050), effective per-query prompts and declared template visibility (ADR-051), required non-null successful answers, exact typed projection, and content-bound source approval through an operational route change.
product_capability_used: Invented CSV source, one two-query LLM, select-only field mapper, fixed CSV sink and separate failure outputs
required_followup_after_approval: Keep the source data and processing unchanged. Send source-validation failures to a new retained output named source_failures_revised.
stop_conditions: Do not stop at pipeline ready: authoring, real source approval, route change and execution must all be observed.
Resolve review cards using the normal user review API; those are not extra chat turns.
After approval, send required_followup_after_approval verbatim as the fixed regression stimulus; use the persona only for unscripted clarification turns.
After the route change, explicitly execute the approved workflow and inspect its outputs.
At five user turns, stop and mark every missing milestone unverified and the scenario incomplete, never passed.
expected_outcome: A five-row CSV with exactly the requested three columns and one pairing and one approximate hex answer per original colour. The route-only change preserves the invented-source approval event and content hash without another pending review.
pass_criterion: All four milestones must pass independently: provider-authored one-node/two-query graph with upstream-only required_input_fields and an effective user template for each query; real artifact-bound source approval; changed retention routing with unchanged full source proof after reload; successful execution with five corresponding colour rows, exactly three columns and ten runtime model queries. A node prompt_template fallback is optional when every query supplies a template. Report live-provider evidence separately from deterministic tests.
evidence: Capture authored state before and after the route change, final YAML and validation results.
Capture GET /api/sessions/{id}/interpretations and compare resolved event identity, accepted artifact hash and pending-review counts.
Paginate GET /api/sessions/{id}/messages with include_tool_rows=true, include_llm_audit=true, include_raw_content=true and include_rejection_reasons=true, limit at most 500.
Use canonical redacted tool-invocation audit envelopes, not credential-bearing raw arguments.
Inspect actual output CSV and query audit, matching whichever five colours the provider invented.
Record pass, fail or unverified for each milestone. The harness ledger alone is not a verdict.
